To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a luminescence-sensor based on coordination compound was developed.

we have developed a new luminescence chemosensor based on coordination compound of [H2 N( CH3)2 ]3 [ Tb ( dipic)3 ] for the highly selective and sensitive detection of Fe(3+) ions in aqueous solution.
we have developed a luminescence-sensor process for detecting Cr(3+) or Fe(3+) in solution and living cells based on coordination compound (H2 N(CH2 CH2 )2 )3 [Tb(3+) (dipic)3 ].
In summary, our research is concerned with

the design and synthesis of new luminescence probes for the detection of Cr(3+) and Fe(3+) in living cells, and a highly sensitive and selective luminescence-sensory process based on coordination compounds is developed, which is interpreted by ESI-MS analysis.
the recognition process of luminescence chemosensor, [H2 N( CH3 )2 ] 3 [Tb( dipic)3 ], for Fe(3+), Cr(3+), and Al(3+).
the recognition and detection of Fe(3+) ions and Cr(3+) ions using a luminescent Tb(3+) -based coordination compound.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the luminescence-sensitizing LnCC [H2 N (CH3 )2 ] 3 [Tb (dipic) 3 ] was synthesized and characterized.
the coordination compound [H(2) N(CH(3))(2)](3)[Tb(dipicolinate)(3)] was successfully applied to the ultrasensitive detection of Fe(3+) in living cells.
the coordination compound [H 2 N(CH 3) 2]3 [Tb (dipic) 3 ] is a highly sensitive and selective luminescence chemosensor for Fe3+ and Cr3+ in aqueous solution.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we developed an ultrasensitive and highly selective lanthanide coordination compound (LnCC) luminescence sensor based on ligand transfer-induced luminescence quenching mechanism.

the luminescent Tb(III) complex [H2 N( CH3 )2 ](3) [Tb(dpic)(3)] can be used for highly selective recognition of Fe(3+) in living cell and the recognition process can be interpreted through ESI-MS analysis.
a new type of lanthanide luminescence-sensor system has been developed.
The main takeaway from our work is that
LnCCs could be used as a luminescent platform to design a highly sensitive chemosensor for the selective detection of metal ions in aqueous solution, living cells, and environmental water.

the coordination compound [H3 N(CH3 )3 ]3 [Tba(dipic)2 ] (1) shows fast response (less than one minute) and high selectivity for Fe3+ or Cr3+ in aqueous solution, and the KSV values of 1 to Fe3+ and Cr3+ are 3.6 × 104 L mol–1 and 1.92 × 104 Lmol–1, respectively.

the luminescence-sensor process based on LnCCs can be used to detect metal ions in aqueous solution, and the whole recognition process can be interpreted by ESI-MS analysis, which is helpful for the further development of luminescence sensors.
